summary: Feed s079_single is degraded: 98.5% of bytes are encrypted, exceeding the NDR's 90% tolerance. All other visibility checks (duplicates, VLANs, directionality, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Near-total encryption (98.54% of bytes) - traffic is predominantly TLS/encrypted flows with no decryption before the packet broker egress. NDR tolerates ~90% encrypted but this feed exceeds it.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload for detection and cannot inspect encrypted payloads. At 98.5% encrypted, deep packet inspection, signature matching, and anomaly detection are blinded, drastically reducing detection coverage for C2, exfiltration and lateral movement.

recommended_fix.why: NDR needs cleartext payload; decrypting relevant TLS at a visibility/decryption zone or forwarding already-decrypted traffic from a TLS-intercept proxy restores inspection capability without changing TAP/SPAN.
